newsitem.title: USA: SCHWAB IN TALKS FOR IPO DEALS.
newsitem.headline: SCHWAB IN TALKS FOR IPO DEALS.

text.p: Charles Schwab said it is in talks with several firms to expand its initial public offering services.
"We've been in discussion with a number of firms and looking to expand the number of offerings and choices. When we're ready to sign a deal, we'll make an announcement," said a Schwab spokeswoman.

She declined to comment on a Wall Street Journal article Thursday that said Schwab is in final negotiations with Credit Suisse First Boston, J.P. Morgan and Hambrecht & Quist. Deals between Schwab and the three banks may be completed as early as next week, the paper said.
Schwab, one of the largest financial services firms, is also the nation's largest online broker.
